parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Optional. open_item (default) — every open document plus unapplied credits/deposits and net payable; or activity — opening balance → chronological ledger with running balance → closing balance.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Required when view=activity. Statement period start (date).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Required when view=activity. Statement period end (date, on or after date_from).
